ridge: equal user/equal present class weights; only four source training users fit mean/scale/intercept/weights
feature_source: Same SHA-verified 7100 IDs and 128-dimensional frozen epoch24 CNN hidden vectors from energy-area source study; no new encoder or raw feature extraction.
code: A has eight nonnegative membership columns LR/RL/UD/DU/CW/CCW/push/empty. Diagonal rows contain two ones; normalize every row to unit length. C=[I12,A]/sqrt(2), all rows unit norm. Permuted control permutes A rows with default_rng(seed), keeps I. Orthogonal control QR of independent seed+1 Gaussian20x12 transposed; CC^T=I. onehot I12.
fitting: Equal training user/present class weighted ridge with intercept. Fit onehot targets at each fixed lambda and multiply coefficients/intercepts by C: algebraically identical to direct code-target ridge. Decode nearest Euclidean codeword. All arms same feature scale and lambda family.
selection: Each arm independently max validation macro, then min common onehot regression MSE, then larger lambda; validation is next cyclic source user. Write complete selection before any diagnostic feature forward or metric. No selection based on held user.
interpretation: Changes output decision metric only; does not create new representation/capacity or demonstrate zero-shot compositionality. Semantic code has smaller distance between related classes, not guaranteed error correction. Not exact binary ECOC reproduction.
audit: Independent sklearn Ridge direct code targets for all72 arm/lambda fits plus explicit codeword distance; independently check validation selection, IDs, all predictions, all file hashes, orthogonal equivalence and old onehot reproduction.
cost: Synthetic4800x128 training/1200validation timing only; 18 family fits with 3x headroom under600seconds before real fitting.
limits: Six reused development users, no pristine test.
